name: lakitu
description: Procgen Knowledge System — structured pipeline ensuring LLMs use proper PCG techniques instead of generate-and-test

nodes.label: User Request
nodes.description: Natural language procgen request. E.g. '10x10 dungeon, walls, gem before altar'

nodes.label: /procgen
nodes.description: Slash command entry point. Defined in .claude/skills/procgen/SKILL.md. Invokes pipeline.py with user arguments.

nodes.label: pipeline.py
nodes.description: Main orchestrator. Coordinates decompose, search, verify, extract, memory, and emit stages. All paths flow through here.

nodes.label: Decompose
nodes.description: Stage 1: Analyzes user request into a typed ProcgenProblem — output structure, constraint list, scale, realtime flag.

nodes.label: Memory Lookup
nodes.description: Stage 2: Searches techniques.md for cached technique cards. Scores by embedding similarity (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 cosine) with syntax_notes penalty. Hit (score >= 0.5) skips to search.

nodes.label: Corpus Search
nodes.description: Stage 3a (on miss): Vector similarity search over local pre-trusted corpus using sentence-transformers. Results are LOCAL_CORPUS / TIMELESS — skip source verification.

nodes.label: Web Search
nodes.description: Stage 3b (on miss): Tries Jina API first, falls back to DuckDuckGo if Jina unavailable. Results go through source verification.

nodes.label: Verify Sources
nodes.description: Stage 3.5: Classifies each web source by category (ACADEMIC, TUTORIAL, BLOG_UNKNOWN...) and freshness (CURRENT, TIMELESS, STALE). Filters out untrustworthy sources.

nodes.label: Extract Techniques
nodes.description: Stage 4: Extracts structured TechniqueCard from each verified source — name, constraint types, implementation pattern, fingerprint, anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Write to Memory
nodes.description: Stage 5: Appends new technique cards to techniques.md as structured markdown sections. Memory grows across sessions.

nodes.label: Select Technique
nodes.description: Stage 6: Scores all extracted techniques by constraint type overlap with the decomposed problem. Best match is selected.

nodes.label: Emit
nodes.description: Stage 6.5: Writes active.json (hook state with fingerprint, anti-patterns, 600s TTL) and outputs the technique card for code synthesis.

nodes.label: Code Synthesis
nodes.description: Stage 7: SMALL_MODEL synthesizes code from the technique card. Max 3 retries with runtime verification, lazy check, and warden gating.

nodes.label: Verification
nodes.description: Stage 8: PostToolUse hook fires on Write/Edit. Checks generated code for fingerprint signals and anti-patterns. Blocks code that falls back to generate-and-test.

nodes.label: DecomposeProblem()
nodes.description: LLM call: request string -> ProcgenProblem. Runs on SMALL_MODEL via OpenRouter.

nodes.label: VerifySource()
nodes.description: LLM call: (url, title, snippet) -> Source. Classifies source category and freshness.

nodes.label: ExtractTechnique()
nodes.description: LLM call: (content, url, problem) -> TechniqueCard. Extracts technique with implementation patterns.

nodes.label: VerifyTechnique()
nodes.description: LLM call: (code, technique, fingerprint, anti_patterns) -> TechniqueVerification. Pass/fail check.

nodes.label: ProcgenProblem
nodes.description: Pydantic model: output_structure (GRID_2D|GRAPH|TREE|SEQUENCE|MESH_3D), constraints[] (name + ConstraintType + description), scale, realtime.

nodes.label: TechniqueCard
nodes.description: Pydantic model: name, category[], problem_types[], constraint_types[], description, tradeoffs[], implementation (language, deps, pattern, complexity), sources[], fingerprint (imports, artifacts, patterns), anti_patterns[], confidence.

nodes.label: Source
nodes.description: Pydantic model: url, domain, title, category (ACADEMIC|TUTORIAL|BLOG_UNKNOWN|...), freshness (CURRENT|TIMELESS|STALE|...), signals[], should_use.

nodes.label: TechniqueVerification
nodes.description: Pydantic model: uses_technique (bool), evidence[], anti_patterns_found[], defaulted_to. The hook's decision structure.

nodes.label: techniques.md
nodes.description: Self-populating knowledge memory. Starts empty, grows each session. Structured markdown with ## headers parseable back into dicts. Currently holds: ASP technique.

nodes.label: active.json
nodes.description: Transient hook communication state. Contains selected technique name, fingerprint, anti-patterns, implementation pattern. Expires after 600 seconds.

nodes.label: corpus_index.pkl
nodes.description: Pickle file containing sentence-transformer embeddings for all indexed corpus documents. Model: multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-dot-v1.

nodes.label: SMALL_MODEL
nodes.description: Configurable via env var (default: anthropic/claude-3.5-haiku). Called through OpenRouter via llm.py. All 8 LLM functions use this — never the main model.

nodes.label: Jina API
nodes.description: s.jina.ai for web search, r.jina.ai for URL-to-markdown reader. Optional — falls back to DuckDuckGo if JINA_API_KEY is absent.

nodes.label: clingo
nodes.description: ASP (Answer Set Programming) solver. The actual constraint solver used in the generated dungeon.py. Guarantees all constraints are satisfied.

nodes.label: MiniLM
nodes.description: sentence-transformers model. Used for corpus search (multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-dot-v1) and technique memory lookup (all-MiniLM-L6-v2).

nodes.label: verify_procgen.py
nodes.description: PostToolUse hook registered in .claude/settings.json. Fires on every Write or Edit of a .py file. Reads active.json, calls VerifyTechnique. Exit 1 blocks the write.

nodes.label: rlm-subcall
nodes.description: Haiku sub-agent (Read tool only). The sub-LM in the RLM pattern. Receives a chunk + query, returns compact JSON with relevant points. Maps to llm_query in the RLM paper.

nodes.label: dungeon.py
nodes.description: The working output. Uses clingo ASP solver directly — inline AnsProlog program encoding all constraints. BFS verification as sanity check. ANSI terminal visualization. Zero generate-and-test.

nodes.label: gen-and-test
nodes.description: first_attempt/dungeon.py — Session 0. Pure generate-and-test: random walls, BFS validation, while attempts < 100. The baseline failure mode lakitu is designed to prevent.

nodes.label: hybrid fail
nodes.description: first_attempt/rlm_dungeon.py — 'ASP-inspired' but still generate-and-test (for attempt in range(1000)). Mimics constraint logic in Python without the solver. The exact failure the PostToolUse hook catches.

nodes.label: /rlm
nodes.description: RLM pattern for processing contexts too large to fit in a window. Chunks structured data, delegates each chunk to rlm-subcall agent, synthesizes results. Activates when techniques.md grows past context limits.

nodes.label: rlm_repl.py
nodes.description: Persistent Python REPL with pickle state. Commands: init, exec, export-buffers. Provides peek(), grep(), chunk_indices(), write_chunks() helpers. The 'external environment' in the RLM paper analogy.

nodes.label: ASP.txt
nodes.description: Chapter 8 of PCG in Games textbook by Nelson & Smith. Covers ASP for maze/level generation. The pre-trusted local corpus document that seeded the first technique card.

nodes.label: llm.py
nodes.description: Shared LLM client. OpenAI SDK pointing at OpenRouter with robust JSON parser (markdown fence stripping, brace-counting extraction). call(prompt, PydanticModel) -> validated instance.
